title: Release scripts' is-main guard is false through a symlink, so the script exits 0 having run nothing
description: Twin of quest-cli QCLI-404 (routed by opum-agent, 2026-09-28). Four release scripts guard main() with `process.argv[1] && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)`. resolve() does not follow symlinks, but Node resolves import.meta.url to the real path, so when a script is invoked through any symlinked path (the macOS tmpdir /var -> /private/var is the common one) the comparison is false, main() never runs, and the process exits 0 with no output. A release gate that silently runs nothing and reports success is the failure this repo's release rules exist to prevent. Sites, read on origin/dev e7f20324: scripts/launcher-equivalence.mjs:322, scripts/pair-receipt.mjs:711, scripts/promote-latest.mjs:1569, scripts/version-parity.mjs:163. Also test/fixtures/quest-cli/version-parity.mjs:117 carries the same guard; it is a vendored copy of quest-cli's script, so it should follow QCLI-404's upstream fix rather than diverge. Measured here 2026-09-28: `node scripts/version-parity.mjs --help` exits 2 with 52 bytes of output; the same file through a symlinked directory (`ln -s $PWD/scripts <scratch>/scripts-link; node <scratch>/scripts-link/version-parity.mjs --help`) exits 0 with 0 bytes. Fix shape: compare realpaths (realpathSync on both sides, tolerating a missing argv[1]); opum-agent OPAG-670 tooling/fleet-sweep/lib/is-main.mjs is one reference shape. Filed only; not scheduled ahead of the current queue. Any change here touches scripts/, so it needs a reviewer pass before landing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: All four scripts (launcher-equivalence, pair-receipt, promote-latest, version-parity) run main() when invoked through a symlinked path, using one shared realpath-based is-main helper rather than four copies
A test invokes each script through a real symlink (created in a tmpdir) and asserts it ran: a non-zero exit or non-empty output where the direct invocation gives one, not merely exit 0
The same test run against the pre-fix guard is shown red (mutation proof), and the direct, non-symlinked invocation stays green on both
Importing each script as a module (as the existing tests do) still does not run main()
test/fixtures/quest-cli/version-parity.mjs is either re-vendored from quest-cli after QCLI-404 lands or its divergence is recorded with a reason
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; an opum-workflow:reviewer pass covers the scripts/ change

plan: 1. One shared realpath-based isMain() in scripts/is-main.mjs; all six guard sites call it (the record names five -- check-breaking-bump.mjs is the sixth, added by LCLI-632 after the record was written).

2. test/lcli637-is-main-symlink.test.ts invokes each script through a real symlink in a tmpdir and asserts it did the same work as the direct run (never exit 0, the defect s own signature), plus a module-import control per script.
3. Mutation proof: restore the pre-fix comparison inside is-main.mjs and show the six symlink cases red, direct/import/tolerance cases green.
4. AC5: record the vendored quest-cli fixture divergence with a by-ref measurement (QCLI-404 unlanded) rather than diverging the fixture.
5. Reviewer pass on scripts/; then bun test + bun run lore check + typecheck + lint green, complete on the branch citing PR + run id.
implementationNotes: SCOPE ADDITION (2026-09-28). LCLI-622 added scripts/github-release.mjs, whose CLI entry uses the same resolve(argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) guard, so it inherits this defect. The fix covers five scripts, not four: launcher-equivalence, pair-receipt, promote-latest, version-parity, github-release.

REVIEW PASS + FINAL EVIDENCE (2026-09-29, branch fix/LCLI-637-is-main-symlink). Head at review: 68c6cb91; review responses committed as fd792a1c. Toolchain: bun 1.3.14, node v24.20.0, lore 0.11.0 (from source), quest 0.11.0.

WHAT SHIPPED. One shared scripts/is-main.mjs (isMain(importMetaUrl)): realpathSync on BOTH sides, false for a missing argv[1] and false (not a throw) for a path that does not exist. Six guard sites now call it, not the five the record names -- scripts/check-breaking-bump.mjs:271 carries the identical defect and was added by LCLI-632 AFTER this record was written; it is a release gate, so a symlinked invocation exited 0 having run nothing. The others: launcher-equivalence:322, pair-receipt:711, promote-latest:1719 (the record said 1569, pre-LCLI-632 numbering), version-parity:163, github-release:303. A repo-wide re-measurement (two grep shapes over argv[1]/fileURLToPath, plus separate searches for import.meta.main, require.main, module.parent and pathToFileURL comparisons) found no seventh site; the unguarded scripts have no guard to be false.

TESTS (test/lcli637-is-main-symlink.test.ts, 19). Per script: a direct control (asserting stderr contains that script's OWN usage text and exit != 0), a symlinked run through a real symlinkSync in mkdtempSync(tmpdir()) asserted byte-equal to the direct run on code/stdout/stderr plus non-empty stderr -- never "exit 0", which is the defect's own signature -- and a module-import control. Plus one test for the helper's non-existent-path tolerance. All six cases are network-free usage refusals; check-breaking-bump needed `--next` with no value rather than `--help`, which is NOT a usage refusal there (it ignores unknown args and runs the real check: measured reading 28 lore sections over gh api in 0.44s).

MUTATION PROOFS. Implementer: with the pre-fix comparison restored inside is-main.mjs, exactly the six symlink cases red (13 pass / 6 fail), direct and import controls green. Reviewer reproduced the same 13/6 independently, and added two mutants of the CONTROLS: isMain->always true reds 12/7 (the six import cases + tolerance), always false reds 7/12 (six direct + six symlink). The reviewer also measured a 17-shape invocation matrix (symlinked dir, symlinked file, symlink chain, hard link, relative argv[1], `..`, trailing slash, symlinked cwd, --preserve-symlinks[-main], bun run, node -e, REPL, a path that exists but is not the module, a firmlink path): no shape where the old guard skipped main() and the new one still does, and none where the new one runs main() when it should not.

REVIEW FINDINGS, all addressed in fd792a1c.
- F1 (BLOCKING, release-only): release.yml materialises version-parity.mjs and check-breaking-bump.mjs with sparse checkouts listing exactly the files each job runs; both scripts now import ./is-main.mjs, so a sparse tree without it fails to LOAD the module (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, exit 1) before the gate runs -- every dispatch, rehearsals included, and this PR's own suite cannot see it because ci.yml never touches those trees. The reviewer reproduced it in a real --no-cone sparse clone and showed the pre-fix file reaching gate logic in the same layout. FIXED: /scripts/is-main.mjs added to all three lists (version-parity job, publish job's own parity gate, breaking-bump job), reason recorded in each block; verified by re-running the sparse clones, where both layouts now load and reach their own checks.
- F2 (medium): test/release-workflow.test.ts's LCLI-616 gate exists for exactly this class but collected only the path written in a run: line, so it was green (58/58) on the tree whose sparse clones crashed. FIXED: the scan now follows transitive relative imports and requires each from the same earlier checkout, in the tree the job runs it from; a new negative control drops the sibling and asserts the three affected jobs are named (predicted subset, then measured), and the two exact pins on the parity sparse list are updated deliberately -- which is what those pins are for.
- F3 (low): AC5's note inferred "no upstream fix" from QCLI-404's task file being present. FIXED: the note now records the decisive reading -- quest-cli's own scripts/qualification/version-parity.mjs has blob 249c28dc at BOTH dev and main, the tree listing is untruncated, and the record is To Do.
- F4 (judgement): six symlink cases skip on win32 by this repo's precedent (a dozen files do the same; creating a symlink on a runner needs elevation). Recorded as unverified coverage -- junction and 8.3 alias shapes -- in the test header, not silently.
- F5 (nits): two comment corrections, the `node -e` argv explanation and one byte-count convention.

GATES AT fd792a1c: bun test 4669 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail (bun printed "Ran 4670 tests across 3013 files" -- the FILE count in this checkout is inflated by gitignored local scratch it still scans for discovery, .repro-scratch/'s three *.test.ts files and the .lore cache; a CI checkout has neither, so the local count runs about 14 tests above CI's); bun run typecheck exit 0; bun run lint exit 0 (4 pre-existing warnings, none in the changed files); bun run lore check (from source, as ci.yml runs it) 82 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.

METHOD NOTE WORTH KEEPING: the LCLI-616 gate's own comment listed its blind spots and imports were not among them, so its green read as the stronger claim its name makes. A gate that asks "is the file there" is not the same as "does it load"; the fix makes it ask the second question, and the negative control is what keeps that claim honest."
finalSummary: Six release scripts no longer silently skip their CLI when invoked through a symlinked path. One shared scripts/is-main.mjs realpaths both sides; all six guard sites call it (the record named five -- scripts/check-breaking-bump.mjs:271, a release gate LCLI-632 added after the record was written, was the sixth, found by re-measuring the inventory). test/lcli637-is-main-symlink.test.ts runs each script through a real symlink in a tmpdir and asserts byte-equality with the direct run, never exit 0 (the defect's own signature); module-import controls per script; the pre-fix mutant reds exactly the six symlink cases (13 pass / 6 fail), reproduced independently by the reviewer, whose always-true and always-false mutants test the controls themselves. Reviewer F1 was blocking and invisible to this PR's suite: release.yml's three sparse checkouts listed only the files each job runs, so the newly imported sibling was missing and every release dispatch (rehearsals included) would have failed at module load -- ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, reproduced in a real --no-cone sparse clone; /scripts/is-main.mjs is now in all three lists. F2: the LCLI-616 checkout gate now follows transitive relative imports, with a negative control naming the three affected jobs, so that class is visible to CI. AC5: quest-cli's QCLI-404 is unlanded (measured three ways, including upstream's own blob at dev and main), so the fixture keeps upstream's bytes and the divergence is recorded beside QUEST_BLOB. Gates at fd792a1c: bun test 4669 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail, typecheck and lint exit 0, bun run lore check 82 files 0 errors.
